🧪 StroopTest

The Stroop effect in game form: a color word (e. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Read the word on screen, then name the ink COLOR it is printed in.
  2. Ignore the word itself — your task is to name the color.
  3. The word and color are deliberately mismatched — that's the challenge.
  4. Answer as quickly and accurately as possible.
  5. Difficulty increases with faster-paced rounds.
